description: Expected output of sp_BalancePerCustomer for various customer names using seed data

test_cases.notes: John Smith has two active accounts (101, 102). Account 101: InitialBalance=5000, Deposits=1000, Withdrawals=-200, Payments=-100 => Net=+700, Current=5700. Account 102: InitialBalance=2000, Deposits=500 => Net=+500, Current=2500.

Bob Johnson has AccountID 104 (active, Checking, Balance=0) and 105 (closed, Savings). Only active accounts returned. Account 104: InitialBalance=0, Deposits=750, Withdrawals=-750 => Net=0, Current=0.

Charlie Brown has AccountID 107 (active, Savings, Balance=0) and 108 (active, Checking, Balance=1500). Account 107: InitialBalance=0, Deposits=1200, Transfer=0 (treated as -0) => Net=+1200, Current=1200. Account 108: InitialBalance=1500, Deposits=300, Withdrawals=-300 => Net=0, Current=1500.
Alice Williams has AccountID 106 (active, Checking, Balance=3000). Account 106: InitialBalance=3000, Deposits=2000, Payments=-500 => Net=+1500, Current=4500.

edge_cases_covered: Zero-balance account (Bob Johnson, AccountID 104: starts at 0, net transactions = 0)
Account with only deposits (Jane Doe, AccountID 103: only deposits and withdrawals but deposits > 0)
Closed account excluded (Bob Johnson, AccountID 105: Status=closed, not in output)
Transfer treated as non-deposit (Charlie Brown: Transfer amount subtracted from balance)
Payment treated as non-deposit (Alice Williams: Payment amount subtracted from balance)
Multiple active accounts for one customer (John Smith: 2 accounts, Charlie Brown: 2 accounts)
